prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with knee injury after a rear-end collision. The patient had 36 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1482; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury is plausible for a crash like this one.
- Treatment grew to many times the usual amount for this injury, with near-daily visits and new body areas added weeks after the crash.
- Imaging and exam findings clearly confirm the injury.
- No earlier injury to the same body area is known.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text: Patient presented following a rear-end motor vehicle collision with complaints of right knee pain and reduced range of motion. The reported mechanism of injury is consistent with the knee trauma described. Imaging and physical examination findings clearly confirm a knee injury. There is no record of prior injury or treatment involving the same region. Over the course of care the patient attended 36 visits, with attendance occurring nearly every day for much of the treatment period. Treatment volume ran well above what is typical for this condition. Several weeks after the collision, complaints were added involving the neck and lower back, which were not part of the initial presentation. Billing records reviewed for this summary show no duplicated or repeated charges for the same services. Ongoing care and reassessment are recommended, with the treatment plan to be reviewed at the next scheduled evaluation.
